claims.text: WSJ (Sept 2026, unnamed Arab officials): Egyptian intelligence chief Abbas Kamel called Netanyahu days before 7 Oct with a third warning; earlier warnings June 2023 (vague) and Sept 2023 (Gaza could explode); neither specified timing or scale; PMO had denied any contact and did not answer the WSJ.

IDF confirmed (May 2024, after FOI suit) Netanyahu received four Military Intelligence warning letters March–July 2023 about how enemies saw damage to national cohesion; the source does not say they warned of a Hamas attack.

28 Oct 2023 Netanyahu posted: 'At no time and no stage was a warning given to Prime Minister Netanyahu regarding war intentions of Hamas', saying security chiefs judged Hamas deterred; deleted and apologised: 'should not have been said and I apologize'.

Channel 12 (Feb 2025): Bar asked Netanyahu on 1 Oct 2023 to approve killing Sinwar; Netanyahu preferred 'quiet in return for quiet'; ~3:30 a.m. 7 Oct Shin Bet saw SIM activations and commanders entering tunnels; Bar's aide called the military secretary at 6:13; Netanyahu called at 6:29. PMO: 'a complete lie', Netanyahu raised eliminating Hamas leaders and Bar recommended civilian benefits.

Ynet Sept 2026: Bar delivered a 'warning of war' to Netanyahu in July 2023 with no date; 1 Oct 2023 excerpts; 3 Oct Shin Bet report saw potential for stability; 3:03 a.m. alert on 'unusual preparations'; Bar instructed update at 5:15, call 6:29; Bar calls it a 'Shin Bet failure'; Netanyahu's 55-page Feb 2026 document blames Bar and says no warning of 'a war in Gaza'; full transcripts unpublished; Bar to sue.

Haaretz/book Kidnapped (Sept 2026): UAE president MBZ warned Netanyahu in a late-Sept 2023 call that Sinwar planned a major operation; Netanyahu reportedly said any action would be in the West Bank; PMO: 'a total lie', no conversation in that period; Halevi and Bar say they were not told.
